mechanism: Fluoxetine increases serotonergic activity which may potentiate dopaminergic effects of levodopa, increasing risk of serotonin syndrome and CNS excitation; additionally, fluoxetine's CYP2D6 inhibition may increase levodopa levels.
action: Monitor for signs of serotonin syndrome (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and levodopa toxicity; consider dose adjustment of either agent or use alternative antidepressant if symptoms emerge.
